-- name: ListCategoryTree
WITH tree AS (
    SELECT
        c.id,
        c.parent_id,
        c.name,
        CAST(c.name AS nvarchar(400)) AS path,
        1 AS depth
    FROM dbo.categories AS c
    WHERE c.parent_id IS NULL
    UNION ALL
    SELECT
        c.id,
        c.parent_id,
        c.name,
        CAST(t.path + N' > ' + c.name AS nvarchar(400)),
        t.depth + 1
    FROM dbo.categories AS c
    JOIN tree AS t ON t.id = c.parent_id
)

SELECT
    t.id,
    t.parent_id,
    t.name,
    t.path,
    t.depth,
    COUNT(p.id) AS product_count
FROM tree AS t
LEFT JOIN dbo.products AS p ON p.category_id = t.id
GROUP BY t.id, t.parent_id, t.name, t.path, t.depth
ORDER BY t.path;
